tiers.role: District Magistrate (DM) / District Collector / Deputy Commissioner
tiers.statutory_mandate: Primary sanctioning authority holding direct legal and personal liability for all MPLADS disbursements under MoSPI Guidelines Section 3.1.
current_pain_points: Overwhelmed by hundreds of technical sanction files during district planning meetings
High political pressure to clear recommendations rapidly from local MPs without time for manual background scrutiny
Personal liability if post-sanction CAG audits uncover duplicate sanctions or ghost works 2 years later
tiers.what_they_actually_care_about: An instant (<200ms) statutory shield before signing: An objective, non-partisan algorithmic green-light or red-flag that justifies rejections without personal political friction.
tiers.setu_intervention: Pre-Sanction Gatekeeper (`/proposals`): Enter proposal details -> Instant clearance tier (Clearance, Audit, Reject) + Tree SHAP citation of exact guideline violated (e.g. GFR 155 smurfing).

tiers.role: Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI) / Central Government
tiers.statutory_mandate: Macro-fiscal monitoring, national scheme equity, answering Parliamentary PAC questions, and safeguarding the annual Rs 5,000+ Crore national outlay.
current_pain_points: Total blindspot on inter-state syndicate cartels operating across state boundaries
Complete reliance on periodic post-mortem audit reports that arrive 18 to 24 months after funds are spent
Massive unspent balances and stalled funds trapped in district administrative bottlenecks
tiers.what_they_actually_care_about: Macro surveillance, systemic leak prevention, and automated PAC-ready compliance dossiers.
tiers.setu_intervention: National Macro GIS Dashboard: Live Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI = 622.5), Zonal Capital Flow Conduits (Eastern 48.6%, Northern 32.1%), and automated cross-border cartel alerts.

tiers.statutory_mandate: Inter-district resource distribution, vendor concentration monitoring, and administrative throughput across state implementing agencies.
current_pain_points: A few dominant executing agencies capture >40% of state contracts, creating severe physical completion bottlenecks
Disparate district performance where favored districts absorb funds while backward districts lag
tiers.what_they_actually_care_about: Balanced vendor participation, elimination of local agency monopolies, and unblocking stalled projects.
tiers.setu_intervention: Statewide Treemap Visualizer: Instant detection of oligopolies (CR3 > 35%, CR5 > 60%) and statutory dwell-sink tracking (>45 days approval delay).

tiers.role: Members of Parliament (Lok Sabha & Rajya Sabha) & Citizens
tiers.statutory_mandate: Constituency development, civic infrastructure delivery, and democratic transparency.
current_pain_points: MPs blamed for stalled or abandoned works caused by corrupt contractors and slow district bureaucracy
Citizens suffer from ghost infrastructure (drinking water borewells or community halls paid for but never built)
tiers.what_they_actually_care_about: Verifiable on-ground completion of public assets and protection of their reputation.
tiers.setu_intervention: Constituency Ledger & Transparent Verification: Public visibility into project milestones and algorithmic assurance that contractor funds yield physical assets.
